Interface VirtualServer<V extends VirtualView>

Type Parameters:
V - the VirtualView subtype used by the implementing transport
All Known Subinterfaces:
VirtualServerRmi
All Known Implementing Classes:
RmiServer
public interface VirtualServer<V extends VirtualView>
Client-to-server action interface, parameterised by the transport-specific VirtualView type.

Implemented by RmiServer (RMI transport) and SocketClientHandler (TCP transport). The type parameter V is the concrete remote-callback type for each transport.

    • loginFirstPlayer

      void loginFirstPlayer(String nickname, int numPlayers, V clientView) throws Exception
      Creates a new lobby and registers the caller as the first player.
      Parameters:
      nickname - the creating player's nickname
      numPlayers - total number of players expected (2–5)
      clientView - the caller's callback view
      Throws:
      Exception - if the transport layer encounters an error

    • loginToLobby

      void pickCard(String nickname, int cardIndex, boolean fromTop) throws Exception
      Picks a card from the specified row of the board.
      Parameters:
